title: Kentucky Department of Revenue
purpose: Home page of Kentucky's state tax agency, with links to individual and business tax information, forms and contacts.
notes: Root domain confirmed as the agency site by many official-result subpages (e.g. revenue.ky.gov/pages/welcome-to-revenue.aspx); root URL itself not returned as a result.

title: MyTaxes (Kentucky Taxpayer Portal)
purpose: Explains and links to Kentucky's MyTaxes portal for filing and paying business taxes such as sales and use, withholding and corporate income/LLET.
notes: Portal login itself is at mytaxes.ky.gov (named in DOR text). MyTaxes replaced OneStop, WRAPS and E-Tax for the covered business taxes.

title: Individual Income Tax
purpose: Information on Kentucky personal income tax filing, forms and requirements for residents and nonresidents.

title: Corporation Income and Limited Liability Entity Tax (LLET) FAQs
purpose: Answers common questions about Kentucky corporation income tax, the limited liability entity tax and pass-through entity filing.
notes: Taxes: Corporation Income Tax and Limited Liability Entity Tax (LLET). FAQ page is the most specific page returned; section landing page not returned as a result.

title: Sales & Use Tax
purpose: Information on Kentucky sales and use tax registration, filing, rates and guidance for businesses.

title: Employer Payroll Withholding
purpose: Guidance for employers on withholding Kentucky income tax from employee wages, filing frequencies and annual reporting.

title: KUIP Employer and TPA Resources
purpose: Resources and login information for employers and third-party administrators using Kentucky's unemployment insurance employer portal (KUIP) to report wages and pay UI contributions.
agency: Kentucky Education and Labor Cabinet, Office of Unemployment Insurance (Kentucky Career Center)
notes: Per official result text, KUIP replaced the older KEWES employer system (kewes.ky.gov) beginning summer 2026.

title: Business Filings Information
purpose: Kentucky Secretary of State page for forming and registering business entities, name availability and reservations.
notes: Online filings via FastTrack (web.sos.ky.gov/fasttrack/default.aspx, also an official result).

title: Annual Reports
purpose: Explains the Secretary of State annual report that Kentucky business entities must file each year and how to file it.

title: Occupational Licenses/Permits (Kentucky Business One Stop)
purpose: Helps businesses find state licenses or permits required for specific activities; general business licenses are handled by cities and counties.
notes: No general statewide business license; licenses are issued by local governments or by occupation. One Stop says certain business types need a special license/permit and that many cities and counties require local business licenses (see onestop.ky.gov/start/Pages/localrequirements.aspx). Link provided for occupation-specific state licenses.

title: Kentucky ABC Licensing Portal (BELLE)
purpose: Online portal for applying for and managing Kentucky alcoholic beverage licenses.
agency: Kentucky Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control
notes: Agency site: abc.ky.gov. Regulation 804 KAR 4:400 requires new license applications through the online portal.

title: Alcohol Tax Rates and Form Requirements
purpose: Lists Kentucky alcohol excise and wholesale sales tax rates and the forms used to report and pay them.
notes: Alcohol excise, wholesale sales and case sales taxes are filed with the Department of Revenue (not ABC). A 2026 bill (HB 9) proposed restructuring these taxes from July 1, 2027; check current law.

title: Business Forms Library (Non-profit Articles of Incorporation)
purpose: Secretary of State forms library that includes the articles of incorporation form for forming a Kentucky nonprofit corporation.
notes: Direct form PDF (official result): https://web.sos.ky.gov/forms/corp/NAI-Articles%20of%20Incorporation-Non-Profit%20Corporation.pdf. Can also file online through FastTrack.

title: Registration Requirements for Charitable Organizations
purpose: Explains what charities soliciting in Kentucky must file with the Attorney General (such as a copy of IRS Form 990 or a notice of intent to solicit).
agency: Kentucky Office of the Attorney General
notes: Professional solicitors register separately: ag.ky.gov/Resources/Consumer-Resources/charity/Pages/solicitors.aspx.

title: Louisiana Department of Revenue
purpose: Home page of Louisiana's state tax agency, with links to individual and business tax information, forms and online services.
notes: LDR uses both revenue.la.gov and revenue.louisiana.gov; both are official.

title: File and Pay Online (LaTAP)
purpose: Links to Louisiana Taxpayer Access Point (LaTAP), LDR's online system for filing returns, making payments and managing state tax accounts.
notes: LDR says electronic filing of state individual and business returns requires a LaTAP login. Combined state/local sales tax returns can be filed on Parish E-File (parishe-file.revenue.louisiana.gov).

title: Individual Income Tax
purpose: Information on Louisiana personal income tax filing, forms and requirements for residents, part-year residents and nonresidents.

title: Corporation Income Tax (and Franchise Tax)
purpose: Explains who must file Louisiana corporation income tax, due dates, extensions and estimated payments, and the status of the corporation franchise tax.
notes: Taxes: Corporation Income Tax and Corporation Franchise Tax (Form CIFT-620). LDR FAQ states the franchise tax is repealed for franchise tax periods beginning on or after January 1, 2026; prior-period obligations can still apply.

title: General Sales & Use Tax
purpose: Information on Louisiana state sales and use tax registration, collection, filing and payment for businesses.
notes: Local (parish) sales taxes are administered separately by local collectors; a combined return is available through Parish E-File.

title: Withholding
purpose: Guidance for employers on registering for, withholding, filing and paying Louisiana income tax withheld from wages.

title: Louisiana's Internet Wage & Tax Reporting
purpose: Louisiana Workforce Commission page explaining how employers report wages and file and pay state unemployment insurance tax online.
notes: Also official results: UI tax rates (www.laworks.net/unemploymentinsurance/ui_lainsurancetaxrates.asp) and Employers page (www.laworks.net/Employers.asp).

title: File Business Documents / geauxBIZ
purpose: Louisiana Secretary of State page for filing formation and other business entity documents, including online through geauxBIZ.
agency: Louisiana Secretary of State, Commercial Division
notes: Online portal: https://geauxbiz.sos.la.gov/ (official result).

title: geauxBIZ (annual report filing)
purpose: Secretary of State online portal where Louisiana corporations, LLCs and other entities file their annual reports.
agency: Louisiana Secretary of State, Commercial Division
notes: Official text says annual report filings for all entity types are available online through geauxBIZ; no dedicated annual-report info page was returned. Fees changed effective 10/1/2026 (Act 921 of 2026).

title: Do I need a license or permit to start my business? (LED)
purpose: Louisiana Economic Development FAQ explaining that business licenses and permits come from local parish/city governments and specific state agencies.
notes: No general statewide business license; licenses are issued by local governments or by occupation. Official sources direct businesses to local parish/city occupational licenses and the geauxBIZ license list.

title: Alcohol and Tobacco Control
purpose: Information on permits from the Louisiana Office of Alcohol and Tobacco Control (ATC) needed to manufacture, distribute or sell alcoholic beverages.
agency: Louisiana Office of Alcohol and Tobacco Control (within LDR)
notes: ATC online licensing portal (official result): https://laatcabc.atc.la.gov/laatcprod/pub/Default.aspx?PossePresentation=LicenseSearch.

title: Alcoholic Beverage Tax
purpose: Explains Louisiana excise taxes on liquor, wine and beer and who must file and pay them.
notes: Filed with LDR. Separate LDR pages exist for wine (revenue.louisiana.gov/businesses/excise/wine/).

title: Forms & Fee Schedule (Nonprofit Articles, Form 395)
purpose: Secretary of State forms and fees page that includes the articles of incorporation form for a Louisiana nonprofit corporation.
agency: Louisiana Secretary of State, Commercial Division
notes: Nonprofit articles are form SS395; can also be filed through geauxBIZ. Fees changed effective 10/1/2026.

title: Charities (Attorney General)
purpose: Louisiana Attorney General page on annual registration of charitable organizations that solicit in Louisiana, and exemptions.
agency: Louisiana Office of the Attorney General, Consumer Protection Section
notes: Related official results: ag.state.la.us/Article/70 and professional solicitors page ag.state.la.us/Page/ProfessionalSolicitors. Authority: La. R.S. 51:1901 et seq.
